description: Renovate for gauntlet on gitlab.tomlawson.io (ai/gauntlet), copied from orbit's renovate.json and cut down to what gauntlet pins (#63): the Go modules in both go.mod files, the pipeline's images, and the Go tools .gitlab-ci.yml and scripts/ install at fixed versions. It runs once a week from the renovate job in .gitlab-ci.yml; docs/releasing.md has the owner's one-time setup.

Go module versions are looked up from each module's own Git host, never through proxy.golang.org: the renovate job sets GOPROXY=direct, and GOPRIVATE for the owner's own modules. A first lookup through the public proxy records a version permanently, so the global rule is never to let one happen by accident.

Not watched, on purpose: golang.org/x/exp/cmd/apidiff, pinned by pseudo-version in scripts/apidiff.sh (CI-only, approved at that pin, owner 2026-09-30, AGENTS.md). golang.org/x/exp has no releases, only commits, and no manager here can rewrite a Go pseudo-version, so this file names it instead of pretending to cover it. It never ships: it only reads gauntlet's exported API in lint:apidiff. Bump it by hand when lint:apidiff fails to load the module under a new Go release, and look at it in each version's release audit.
The dependency dashboard is off, as on orbit (owner, 2026-09-08): a bot-written issue that never reaches a done state and is stale between runs.
This file is read two ways: as the repository config Renovate finds on dev, the default branch, and as the global config the renovate job points RENOVATE_CONFIG_FILE at. Both are the same file.

gomod.description: Both modules: the library's go.mod and gate/contracttest/go.mod, the contract tests' own module (#30). The manager's default file pattern matches every go.mod in the repository. go mod tidy after each bump keeps go.sum complete, which lint:go's -mod=readonly build insists on.

customManagers.description: The pipeline pins its job images in the top-level variables block -- GOLANG_IMAGE and ALPINE_IMAGE -- and the jobs reference them as $GOLANG_IMAGE. The gitlabci manager reads image: keys, so it sees the references and never the pins. This reads the pins. The dependency-proxy prefix is skipped, so the lookup is the Docker Hub name (library/golang) the proxy fronts.

golangci-lint, built from source with `go install ...@vX.Y.Z` in lint:go and test:contract. No manager reads a version inside a shell command. A new major moves the module path (/v2 to /v3) as well as the version, so a major bump from here is wrong as written and needs the path changed by hand; majors are never grouped (see packageRules).

govulncheck, installed at a fixed version in lint:vulncheck and named at the same version in AGENTS.md's check list, so both move together. golang.org/x/vuln is developed on go.googlesource.com; its tags are mirrored to github.com/golang/vuln, which is where this looks.

gitleaks, installed at a fixed version in lint:secrets. The module path still says zricethezav/gitleaks; the project moved to the gitleaks organisation on GitHub, which is where its releases are published.
go-licenses, the licence gate's scanner, pinned as GO_LICENSES_VERSION's default in scripts/licence-check.sh.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes do not wait for Monday. GitLab CE has no dependency-alert API for Renovate to read, so osvVulnerabilityAlerts above supplies the advisories, from the OSV database, and this lets a fix for one open outside the weekly window.

packageRules.description: Every non-major update, from every manager, lands as one merge request, as on orbit: one pipeline a week rather than one per dependency. Majors stay out of the group so a breaking change is reviewed on its own.

The owner's own modules are never looked up. gate/contracttest/go.mod requires github.com/tomlawesome/gauntlet only to replace it with the checkout (replace => ../..), and a version lookup would ask the public module proxy about a module the owner publishes (AGENTS.md, global rules).

Modules AGENTS.md approves at a named version (owner, 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-04). Renovate may offer newer versions of these on purpose -- staleness checking is the point of #63 -- but the approval names a version, so the merge request says what has to move with it.
prBodyNotes: AGENTS.md ("Approved third-party modules") names the version the owner approved for this module. Before merging: update that line, check that any new module this version pulls in is one the owner has approved, and confirm `lint:licences` is green.

packageRules.description: Renovate's own image, which the gitlabci manager finds in the renovate job. Same exclusion as orbit's: 44.63.0 and 44.64.0 do not start (their apk datasource imports `tar`, which the image lacks). Nothing in CI runs this job, so a bump is only proven by the next scheduled run: if that run fails at start-up, revert the bump and add the version here.
